title: Consolidate duplicate X-reflection mirror math through MirrorUtility (A5a/H2)
description:
## Summary

Four independent `Matrix4x4.Scale(new Vector3(-1,1,1))` X-reflection definitions exist and are not routed through a single shared utility:
- `MirrorUtility.cs:27` ReflectAcrossX (used once)
- `SdfProgramBuilder.cs:57` CreatureMirrorAcrossX (used once)
- `SemanticBoneResolver.cs:29` ReflectAcrossX (public, aliased by SkeletonInferrer.cs:73)
- `CreatureMeshGenerator.cs:33` ReflectAcrossX (used once)

Source: docs/audits/creaturecreator-latest-main-audit-26-09-05-01-40-00.md (H2 carried) and docs/audits/creaturecreator-deep-dive-audit-2026-09-05.md F4. Re-verified at HEAD 2a89605 (duplication unchanged). Former owner CC-090's MemorySmith task TSK-0094 is Done for finite-check scope only and does NOT cover this mirror slice; no active owner exists. NOTE: MirrorUtility is not uniquely the least-referenced (three private copies tie at one in-file usage each) — justify consolidation by duplication, not by a reference-count ranking.

## Scope

- Route the duplicate X-reflection matrix math through the existing `MirrorUtility.ReflectAcrossX`.
- Keep domain decisions (e.g. "this limb is mirrored") outside the utility.
- Pure reference swap; no semantic change.
- Cover SdfProgramBuilder, SemanticBoneResolver, and CreatureMeshGenerator sites; keep SkeletonInferrer delegating to the shared resolver.

## Acceptance Criteria

- One X-reflection matrix definition is referenced by all sites.
- Deterministic/canonicalization, SDF parity, and mesh output are unchanged.
- No new raw-DNA or derivation path is introduced.

## Validation

- `dotnet build` Runtime + Tests.Runtime pass 0 errors/warnings.
- Existing SDF parity, canonicalization, mirrored-limb, and mesh suites stay green.
- `git diff --check` passes.

## Findings

- H2 confirmed unchanged at HEAD; 4 independent definitions; consolidation is a cheap, low-risk reference swap.

## Blockers

- None identified. Related to TSK-0105 (active geometry-utility consolidation) and TSK-0094 (CC-090, Done for finite checks only).

## Next Step

- Consolidate the four X-reflection definitions onto MirrorUtility.ReflectAcrossX; run parity/canonicalization/mesh validation.
